scope: Generated nonuniform ordinary 3D degree-four and clamped positive-weight rational 3D degree-five splines.
reference: ezdxf 1.4.5 BSpline.point endpoint and interior samples.
validation: Before the change both independent high-degree samples produced no segments.
Thirty focused geometry tests pass, including distance to independent samples, invalid zero-weight refusal and degree-65 limit control.
Five focused standalone spline tests pass with each bundled and current shared codec, including generated degree-four and degree-five ASCII/Binary save/reopen and high-degree import note.
Six bundled and ten shared HATCH/MPOLYGON controls pass.
limitations: The approximation is bounded by 1e-4 of input control-point extent subject to finite-value, positive-weight, depth-16, 8192-segment and degree-64 limits. Failed approximation produces no high-degree display segments and reports an import note.
Only generated degree-four and degree-five profiles were independently sampled; other degrees and producer files remain unqualified.
Headless macOS ARM64 only; native GUI, hosted CI, and other platforms remain open. Current shared-codec build uses scratch CMake glue.
